items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: Sam Morgan might have been on your neighborhood.

ctx.x: So you were, uh, you were wandering around in the, uh, in the quarter. Where did you live in the corner?
On the corner of St. Louis and Dauphin. Sam Morgan might have been on your neighborhood.
Maybe, uh, although I wasn't aware of him. Yeah.
